milestones.title: Your first season has resolved
milestones.body: The world has answered your orders. Read the Dispatch, then compare the changes with the plans you made. A headline records an event; it does not promise the next outcome.
milestones.question: Help me read this resolved season. Which visible change deserves my attention first, and what should I check before acting?

milestones.title: A building is ready to serve
milestones.body: Construction has completed at {region}. Review the building's benefits and burdens, then check the city's reported condition. Completing a building is a beginning, not proof that its people are better governed.
milestones.question: What should I review after this construction completed? Explain its visible benefits, burdens and the relevant city reports.

milestones.title: Orders have become action
milestones.body: An army has moved or a recruited unit has mustered. Check its position, movement allowance and upkeep before the next order. An intended route and a completed move are different things.
milestones.question: Help me understand this military milestone. What should I verify about movement, orders and upkeep without exposing hidden enemy details?

milestones.title: The realm is asking for attention
milestones.body: A resolved season has brought a treasury or public-order warning. Open the relevant breakdown before changing policy; the largest visible symptom may not be its underlying cause.
milestones.question: Help me investigate this treasury or public-order warning using the supplied reports. What is known, what may be stale, and which tradeoff should I examine first?

milestones.title: Peace has given way to conflict
milestones.body: A new war or battle now concerns your faction. Review diplomacy, your own forces and visible order previews. Counsel can explain a choice, but cannot promise a victory or reveal an unseen enemy roster.
milestones.question: Help me orient after this war or battle. Which visible facts and decisions matter now, and what remains uncertain?

ui.title: Marcus notices your progress
ui.blocked: Finish the turn presentation and Dispatch, or resolve the active battle and pending city defense, before responding to tutorial invitations.
ui.empty: No new tutorial invitation is waiting. The lessons remain available whenever you want them.
ui.source: WRITTEN TUTORIAL · NO AUTOMATIC VOICE CONNECTION
ui.help: These invitations are optional and belong to this saved campaign. Reading never changes orders or advances time. Acknowledging, dismissing or postponing only changes tutorial progress.
